title: Kunneth isomorphism for quasi-coherent cohomology over a field
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], let X and Y be schemes over k [def-pc-scheme], and let F and G be quasi-coherent modules on X and Y [pqf-def-coherent]. If X and Y are quasi-compact and have affine diagonals, then for every integer n >= 0 the canonical cup-product map H^n(X \times_{\operatorname{Spec}(k)} Y, \operatorname{pr}_1^*F \otimes_{\mathcal O_{X \times_{\operatorname{Spec}(k)} Y}} \operatorname{pr}_2^*G) \cong \bigoplus_{p+q=n} H^p(X,F) \otimes_k H^q(Y,G) is an isomorphism. The canonical map is obtained by pulling cohomology classes back along the two projections and applying the cup product, and is functorial for pullback along morphisms of schemes over k.

lean.statement: theorem picard_kunneth_qcoh (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal g)] (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] : (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n}, scalarCohomology f F i.val.1 ⊗[k] scalarCohomology g G i.val.2) ≃ₗ[k] scalarCohomology (Limits.pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n, ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n}) (a : scalarCohomology f F i.val.1) (b : scalarCohomology g G i.val.2), e (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun j : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n} ↦ scalarCohomology f F j.val.1 ⊗[k] scalarCohomology g G j.val.2) i (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) = cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (Limits.pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property) (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2 a b)) ∧ (∀ (X' Y' : Scheme.{w}) (f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g' : Y' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (u : X' ⟶ X) (v : Y' ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ f = f') (hv : v ≫ g = g') (w : Limits.pullback f' g' ⟶ Limits.pullback f g) (h₁ : w ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f g = Limits.pullback.fst f' g' ≫ u) (h₂ : w ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f g = Limits.pullback.snd f' g' ≫ v) (p q : ℕ) (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology g G q), scalarCohomologyMap (Limits.pullback.fst f' g' ≫ f') (externalCupPullbackIso f g f' g' u v w h₁ h₂ F G).hom (p + q) (scalarCohomologyPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (Limits.pullback.fst f' g' ≫ f') w (by rw [← Category.assoc, h₁, Category.assoc, hu]) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) (p + q) (externalCup f g F G p q a b)) = externalCup f' g' ((tensorPullback u).obj F) ((tensorPullback v).obj G) p q (scalarCohomologyPullback f f' u hu F p a) (scalarCohomologyPullback g g' v hv G q b))
